div.head: VI As 9
div.ab: Nígoðe, þæt we cwædon be þisum þeofum þe man on hrǽdinge fule geaxian ne mæg: ⁊ man eft geaxað, þæt he fúl bið ⁊ scildig, þæt se hlaford hine oððe þa magas on þæt ilce gerád útniman, þe man þa menn útnimð, þe æt ordale fule weorðað.

Nonum: Diximus de illis latronibus, qui in hredinge noxii nequeunt (nequeunt culpabiles) inueniri: et postmodum inquiritur, quod inmundus sit et reus (rei sint et immundi), ut dominus uel parentes eius eodem modo educant eum (eorum sic educant eos), quomodo educitur qui in ordalio est reus inuentus (contaminatus inuenitur).

Nígoðe: Þæt we cwædon be þisum þeofum þe man on hrǽdinge fule geaxian ne mæg ⁊ man eft geaxað, þæt he fúl bið ⁊ scildig; þæt se hlaford hine oððe þa magas on þæt ilce gerád útniman, þe man þa menn útnimð, þe æt ordale fule weorðað.

Neuntens, dass wir bestimmt haben über diese Diebe, welche man nicht auf der Stelle als schuldig erweisen kann, [von denen] man jedoch nachher nachweist, dass er überführt und schuldig ist: dass ihn der Herr oder die Verwandten aus [der Haft] unter derselben Bedingung [an sich] nehmen, wie man die Leute herausnimmt, welche beim Ordal überführt werden.

Ninthly, that we have determined concerning those thieves whom one cannot prove guilty on the spot, [but of whom] it is afterwards proved that he is convicted and guilty: that the lord or the kinsmen take him out [of custody] on the same condition as those people are taken out who are convicted at the ordeal.

Ninth: With respect to those thieves who cannot be proved guilty on the spot, but who are subsequently convicted and proved guilty: we have declared, that such a one may be liberated from prison by his lord or his relatives, on the same terms as apply to the liberation of men who have been proved guilty at the ordeal.

Ninthly: we have pronounced concerning those thieves that we cannot hastily prove guilty; if such a one is afterwards proved guilty and liable, the lord or the kinsmen are to redeem him on the same terms as one redeems those men who are convicted at the ordeal.
